description: This file is a shell script used for automated end-to-end testing and orchestration of a Parallels VM running macOS. It manages snapshot resolution, VM state, installation, verification, and reporting, including integration with external services like Discord. It contains functions for VM control, network operations, and process management, specifically tailored for orchestrating smoke testing of a macOS environment within a PaaS setup.

methods.name: say
methods.description: Outputs an informational message prefixed with '==>' to indicate progress.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message prefixed with 'warn:' to standard error.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message to standard error and exits the script with status 1.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup tasks, terminating server processes and removing temp directories.

methods.name: shell_quote
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe usage in shell commands.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information about script options.

methods.name: resolve_snapshot_info
methods.description: Retrieves and selects the most relevant VM snapshot based on a hint, using difflib similarity scoring.

methods.name: resolve_host_ip
methods.description: Determines the host IP address for VM communication, either from provided input or detected via network configuration.

methods.name: is_host_port_free
methods.description: Checks whether a specified TCP port is available.

methods.name: allocate_host_port
methods.description: Finds and returns an available system TCP port.

methods.name: resolve_host_port
methods.description: Resolves the host port to use, either the specified one if free or a new allocated port.

methods.name: wait_for_vm_status
methods.description: Waits until the VM reaches an expected status or timeout occurs.

methods.name: wait_for_current_user
methods.description: Waits until the VM's current user is available, indicating login readiness.

methods.name: host_timeout_exec
methods.description: Runs a command with a host-side timeout, terminating if it exceeds the specified duration.

methods.name: snapshot_switch_with_retry
methods.description: Attempts to switch VM snapshots with retries, handling stuck VM states.

methods.name: guest_current_user_exec
methods.description: Executes a command inside the VM as the current user.

methods.name: guest_current_user_cli
methods.description: Runs a shell command in the VM as the current user through script assembly.

methods.name: guest_script
methods.description: Runs a block of code inside the VM, supporting different modes (e.g., current-user).

methods.name: guest_current_user_sh
methods.description: Builds and executes a shell script inside the VM as the current user.

methods.name: restore_snapshot
methods.description: Restores a VM snapshot and, if needed, powers down the VM.

methods.name: resolve_latest_version
methods.description: Fetches the latest release version from npm.

methods.name: install_latest_release
methods.description: Installs the latest release of openclaw via a URL.

methods.name: verify_version_contains
methods.description: Checks whether the current openclaw version contains a specified substring.

methods.name: extract_package_version_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts version info from a tarball of the package.

methods.name: extract_package_build_commit_from_tgz
methods.description: Extracts build commit hash info from a tarball.

methods.name: pack_main_tgz
methods.description: Creates a tgz package of the current main build or given target package.

methods.name: verify_target_version
methods.description: Checks that the built package version matches expectations.

methods.name: current_build_commit
methods.description: Returns the commit hash of the current build info JSON.

methods.name: current_control_ui_ready
methods.description: Checks if control UI index exists, indicating build completion.

methods.name: acquire_build_lock
methods.description: Obtains a file lock to serialize build operations.

methods.name: release_build_lock
methods.description: Releases the build lock.

methods.name: ensure_current_build
methods.description: Ensures that the current code is built and ready, rebuilding if necessary.

methods.name: stage_pack_runtime_deps
methods.description: Runs a script to stage runtime dependencies for the build.

methods.name: start_server
methods.description: Starts a local HTTP server to host the tgz package.

methods.name: install_main_tgz
methods.description: Installs the built tgz into the VM via HTTP server.

methods.name: verify_bundle_permissions
methods.description: Checks that installed npm packages have appropriate permissions.

methods.name: run_ref_onboard
methods.description: Performs onboarding to the remote service in ref mode.

methods.name: verify_gateway
methods.description: Verifies the status of the OpenClaw gateway inside the VM.

methods.name: show_gateway_status_compat
methods.description: Compatibly shows gateway status, depending on available CLI options.

methods.name: verify_turn
methods.description: Sets the model and verifies agent response.

methods.name: resolve_dashboard_url
methods.description: Obtains the dashboard URL from the VM.

methods.name: verify_dashboard_load
methods.description: Loads dashboard page and verifies its structure and connection.

methods.name: configure_discord_smoke
methods.description: Configures Discord bot integration for smoke testing.

methods.name: discord_message_id_from_send_log
methods.description: Extracts message ID from Discord message send logs.

methods.name: wait_for_discord_host_visibility
methods.description: Waits until the host can see the message in Discord channel.

methods.name: post_host_discord_message
methods.description: Posts a message to Discord from the host.

methods.name: wait_for_guest_discord_readback
methods.description: Verifies that the guest VM can read back the Discord message.

methods.name: run_discord_roundtrip_smoke
methods.description: Performs a full roundtrip messaging test with Discord.

methods.name: show_log_excerpt
methods.description: Outputs the last lines of a test log file for diagnostics.
